name: Bamboo-tube rice
summary: Rice grilled in a bamboo tube and eaten with sesame salt that is fragrant and nutty.
origin: Pac Ngoi. VOV, 25 September 2019. Thái Nguyên, 1 April 2026. VnExpress handbook, updated 4 February 2025.
taste: The Thái Nguyên notice calls the sesame salt fragrant and nutty beside the tube.
howToEat: Split the tube. Thái Nguyên eats it with muối vừng. Vietnam Tourism's rural desk, on 29 September 2025, also sets it beside crisp-fried stream fish.
The handbook lists “cơm lam, cá nướng thịt chua, xôi ngũ sắc” at Pac Ngoi. That line is not split into a separate sour-meat dish.
where: Pac Ngoi, at the house, and at the 2019 weekend market.
